title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to execute Modification No. 3 to Contract No. OP749030003367 with Clean Energy to continue to provide Operation and…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0712, Contract]
[OPERATIONS, SAFETY, AND CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (5-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to execute Modification No. 3 to Contract No. OP749030003367 with Clean Energy to continue to provide Operation and Maintenance (O&M) services of Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) fueling stations at Divisions 1, 3, 5, 7, 10 and 18 and increase the Not-To-Exceed (NTE) amount of the first one-year option by $800,000 from $1,124,656 to $1,924,656, and exercise the first one-year option, increasing the total contract NTE amount from $9,462,159 to $11,386,815, and extend the period of performance from March 1, 2027 through February 29, 2028.
